decisive_items: negativity for CD15, CD3, CD20, ALK, CD45Ro, and EMA
response.rationale: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma is supported by CD30-positive large pleomorphic cells with kidney-shaped nuclei and Reed–Sternberg-like cells; CD15 negativity and lack of B/T-cell markers exclude Hodgkin lymphoma and mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma, while non-Hodgkin lymphoma is too broad.

rejected.why: CD20 negativity excludes mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma.
CD15 negativity and the immunophenotype are against Hodgkin lymphoma.
